dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: The new business deal's not confirmed yet?

dialogues.speaker: Alexandra
dialogues.text: The cargo ship's been found, but I haven't found a suitable harbor, so the ship can't dock and unload for now...

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: *sigh* We have to hurry. We can't leave the cargo for too long.

dialogues.speaker: Alexandra
dialogues.text: How will we handle the batch of goods that doesn't have confirmed buyers after the ship arrives?

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: Hm, when the time comes, we will dispose of that batch of old goods.

dialogues.speaker: Przheva
dialogues.text: But it still depends on how much cargo that ship is carrying...
